g.text: MarieRank3Convo4 begins.
Update boolean MarieLyonAvailable
วันก่อนฉันได้คุยกับ Monsieur Loid เกี่ยวกับวัยเด็กของเขา แล้วฉันก็มีคำถามจะถามคุณ
I'm sorry. You what?
I... don't... know how to feel about this.
อยากจะถามว่าอะไร?
[จบ]
He was telling me about his youth. Ai-je fait quelque chose qui vous a offensé ?
I do not understand. Ai-je fait quelque chose qui vous avez offensé ?
Archimedeans - were they Orokin ? Or were they not ? The word gets used with such frivolity.
Chat ends.
I guess I'm just... jealous.
I guess I'm just... surprised.
I could ask the devil, I suppose. But I do not like to talk to him if I can help it.
De la jalousie ? Pourquoi ?
Pourquoi ?
ไม่ใช่ พวกอาร์คิมีดีนมีตำแหน่งต่ำกว่า Orokin
Orokin Empire is called that because the Orokin ran it, but the Orokin was also just the name of the ruling class.
+10 Chemistry
I'm just a little taken aback you know more about him now than I do.
I don't know anything about Loid's past, and I've known him for a while.
This happens a lot. You're not alone.
Oh ! Do not take it personally, s'il vous plaît !
Did the Orokin purposefully make their society confusing and obtuse ?
Monsieur Loid is, what is the word, distant ?
Thousands of years of being in charge, and people get... bored. Bored people make complicated systems.
They had a taste for the ornate and the intricate. It extended to bureaucracy.
Honestly? I'm starting to think so.
I don't know anything about him, really.
He's a bit aloof, yes.
+10 Chemistry
Look at with whom I spend my time with, oui ? Learn to read one statue and it is not too hard to learn to read another.
I think they did it just to be annoying !
+10 Chemistry
Et ils se demandent pourquoi des rébellions éclatent. Vous aviez peut-être vos warframes, mais nous avions nos guillotines !
Though I admit Monsieur Loid is a bit more... piquant than dear Lyon.
Vive la révolution !
He has his reasons.
Anyway... What was your question?
Should I be concerned?
Vive la révolution ! I think.
I'm not quite sure what just happened, but I think I agree?
Yes, he certainly does.
Ah ! Yes.
Do not mind me, I am just having a bit of fun. Silly little Marie la révolutionnaire.
+10 Chemistry
I fear I have entirely forgotten what I have come here to ask you now ! Ha ! Oh well. It will come to me.
Thank you for answering my question, I should let you go on your way.
I apologize for disrupting your day. Or evening. Or whatever time it is, whenever and wherever you have found yourself.
À la revoyure !
Chat ends.
